# Vouris

> > Sales strategy and execution consulting for early-stage B2B startups, founded by Kyle Vamvouris

Vouris helps startup founders and sales leaders build repeatable revenue engines through inside sales playbooks, prospecting frameworks, and sales team structure guidance. The site features actionable content on cold outreach, sales methodologies like Sandler and JTBD, and practical templates for SDR teams.

## Key Topics

- Inside Sales
- Sales Prospecting
- Cold Calling
- Cold Email
- SDR Training
- B2B Sales
- Sales Strategy
- Sales Operations
- Lead Generation
- Sandler Sales Methodology
- Jobs To Be Done (JTBD)
- Sales Metrics
- Pipeline Management
- LinkedIn Prospecting
- Sales Team Structure

## Core Sales Playbooks & Strategy

- [The Inside Sales Playbook That Has Generated Thousands of Qualified Leads](https://www.vouris.com/blog/inside-sales-playbook): Inside sales playbook guide covering process, SDR training, and operations
- [Understanding the Role of Inside Sales in Business](https://www.vouris.com/blog/inside-sales): Comprehensive guide to inside sales techniques and best practices
- [Exploring Sales Team Structures: Roles, Size, and Responsibilities](https://www.vouris.com/blog/sales-team-structure): Guide to designing effective sales team structures and roles
- [How to Use Metrics to Manage Your Startup's Sales Team](https://www.vouris.com/blog/sales-metrics-for-startups): Sales metrics and KPIs for startup sales team management
- [How Clear Are Your Deal Stages?](https://www.vouris.com/blog/deal-stages): Guide to defining clear deal stages and pipeline management

## Prospecting & Outreach Tactics

- [The LinkedIn Prospecting Hack That Got a 52% Reply Rate](https://www.vouris.com/blog/linkedin-prospecting): LinkedIn prospecting strategy achieving 52% reply rate
- [6 Simple Steps to Find & Reach B2B Decision Makers](https://www.vouris.com/blog/how-to-find-decision-makers-in-a-company): Six-step process for finding and reaching B2B decision makers
- [Writing Your Very Own Cold Call Script](https://www.vouris.com/blog/writing-your-very-own-cold-call-script): Guide to writing effective cold call scripts for pipeline building
- [5 Steps to Getting Past the Gatekeeper](https://www.vouris.com/blog/how-to-get-past-the-gatekeeper): Five-step strategy for handling gatekeepers in cold calling

## Sales Methodologies & Frameworks

- [Introduction to the Sandler Sales Methodology](https://www.vouris.com/blog/sales-training-sandler): Comprehensive intro to Sandler Sales Methodology for B2B teams
- [Use Job Stories to Get Inside Your Buyers' Heads](https://www.vouris.com/blog/job-stories): Using JTBD framework and job stories for sales messaging and outreach
